name: Kanjo College
description: Kanjo College — a block theme for an accountancy training college for adults. A pale slate-mist ground carries ledger rules and a red margin line; the home page opens on a 48 px rounded photograph window with a vertical caption, an index numeral and three outline stickers, a ledger path that winds to a signpost, and a fixed bottom route bar whose pencil marker walks Enrol, Weeks 1–4, Mock paper, Exam week and Results as you scroll. It continues with four outlined portrait paper cards with overlapping pill labels, a horizontal twelve-week row, an evening study-room parallax, the lecturer ledger, a ruled fee table, learner stories and a slate band for taking a place. Schibsted Grotesk for headings, Instrument Sans for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
